status.description:
Job status

- unknown: The job status is unknown
- waiting: The job is waiting to be processed
- active: The job is currently being processed
- failed: The job has failed. The root 'errors' array may contain more details
- completed: The job has completed. The 'result' field will contain the job result

result.description: If the job is finished, this will return the result of the job (e.g. the skin UUID)

timestamp.description: Timestamp (in milliseconds) when the job was created

eta.description: Estimated timestamp (in milliseconds) when the job will be completed. Only present after first submitting the job.
